music.prompt: Instrumental background music for a one-minute product explainer of a playful developer tool. Bright, minimal and bouncy: muted marimba and plucked synth over a light shuffled beat with soft claps and a round sub bass, about 104 BPM. Friendly and confident, uncluttered so a voice-over sits on top. A small lift around 22 seconds and another around 42 seconds. In the last 6 seconds it gathers into a clean, happy final hit and a short ringing tail.

voices.text:
[curious] You built something. A site, a bot, a little app.
[playfully] Now: who gets to open it?
[warmly] This is kitchen. Push a repo, and share it with a circle.
voices.previous_text: Now: who gets to open it?

voices.text:
Kitchen deploys your GitHub repos to Cloudflare, and to your own machines.
Push to main, and it's live. Every pull request gets its own preview.
voices.previous_text: Push a repo, and share it with a circle.

voices.text:
Then, the map. Every app is a card. Every circle is a group: an email, a domain, or everyone.
Drag a card into a circle, and see the change before you drop. [pleased] Undo is right there.
voices.previous_text: Every pull request gets its own preview.
voices.next_text: Kitchen turns the map into Cloudflare Access.

voices.text: Kitchen turns the map into Cloudflare Access, so only those circles get in.
voices.next_text: Containers run on your own machines.

voices.text:
Containers run on your own machines, through a tunnel, with no open ports.
[playfully] Machine off? Visitors get a friendly page, not an error.
voices.previous_text: so only those circles get in.
voices.next_text: Kitchen. Push a repo. Share it with a circle.
